purpose: Upstream ZXing blackbox samples fetched for #213 independent decode verification (pyzbar cross-check recorded).

source.license: Apache-2.0 (upstream repo root LICENSE, copied here)

pyzbar_reference.note: zbar emits the GS1 AI 01 element string; the local boundary prefixes 01 to the bare 14-digit GTIN so public results keep this baseline
zbar expands UPC-E to its EAN-13 equivalent; the local boundary applies UPCEReader.convertUPCEtoUPCA plus the leading zero to keep this baseline
zbar's default decode never surfaces the EAN2/EAN5 add-on as a separate result; the local boundary drops UPC_EAN_EXTENSION to keep this baseline

user-accepted readable-text difference: zbar strips the AI parentheses, but the pinned ZXing 0.16.11 Result.RawBytes is null, so original GS/FNC1 separators cannot be recovered losslessly (not merely a missing AI table — e.g. batch numbers containing parentheses are ambiguous). Kept as (AI)value; raw-element-string consumers need a decoder boundary that preserves raw data
